Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue. West Triangle. Quezon City http: dilg.gov_ph OPINION NO. 03 AUG MAYOR REXLON T. GATCHALIAN Valenzuela City Metropolitan Manila Dear Mayor Gatchalian: This has reference to your letter dated 19 June 2017 requesting this Department's legal position on the issue of whether or not the Valenzuela City Government may put up a Blood Bank to be financed by the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund (LDRRMF). 2. In this regard, please find hereunder this Department's legal position: DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2015-76 dated July 21, 2015, entitled "EARLY PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS TO REDUCE DISASTER RISK", particularly Section 3 thereof, to wit: "Pursuant to IRR Rule 6, Sec. 4(3) of RA 10121, cause the preparation, review and/or updating of a Contingency Plan which, at the minimum, includes scheme for: xxv xxx xxv emergency response; medical and counselling services and NDRRMC-DBM-DILG Joint Memorandum Circular (JMC) No. 2013-1 dated March 25, 2013 on the "ALLOCATION AND UTILIZATION OF THE LOCAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENI" FUND". Item 4 (Allocation for the LDRRMF) provides that: Section 21 of RA No. 10121 provides that the LDRRMFamounting to no less than five percent (5%) of the estimated revenue from regular sources shall be set aside to support disaster risk management activities such as, but not limited to the pre-disaster preparedness programs including training, purchase of disaster response and rescue equipment, supplies and medicines, for post- disaster activities and payment of premiums on calamity insurance.

-The LDRRMF shall cover the thirty percent (30%) lump-sum allocation for Quick Response Fund (QRF) and the seventy percent (70%) allocation for disaster prevention and mitigation, preparedness, response, rehabilitation and recovery. Moreover, Item 5.2.12 of the said JMC provides that: "5.2. The knowledge and capacities developed by governments, professional response and recovery organizations, comm unities and individuals to effectively anticipate, respond to, and recover from the impacts of likely, imminent or current hazard events or conditions. Preparedness action is carried out within the context of disaster risk reduction and management and aims to build the capacities needed to efficiently manage all types of emergencies and achieve orderly transitions from response to sustained reco very. Projects and Activities: XXX XXX XIXX 5.5.12. Other programs or projects of similar nature and considered necessary. The above-stated issuances were crafted for the proper implementation of Republic Act (R A) No. 10121, otherwise known as the "Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010". Hence, the proposed projects of the LGU should conceptualize a safer and disaster resilient communities to meet the needs of its people. The herein proposed project encompasses disaster preparedness by establishing and strengthening the capacities of the city government to anticipate, cope and recover from the negative impacts and will eventually help prevent the loss of lives of those affected. Foregoing considered, this level is of the view that putting —up a Blood Bank can be considered within the purview of "Disaster Preparedness". However, this Department would like to give emphasis on Section 9 of Republic Act No. 7719, otherwise known as the "National Blood Services Act of 1994", viz: "SEC. 9. Regulation of Blood Sciences. — It shall be unla vvful for any' person to establish and operate a blood bank/center unless it is registered and issued a license to operate by the Department: Provided, that in case of emergencies, blood collection and transfusion under the responsibility of [he attending physician shall be allowed in hospitals without such license under

certain conditions prescribed by the Department. No license shall be granted or renewed by the Department for the establishment and operation ofa blood bank/ center unless it complies with the standards prescribed by the Department. Such blood bank/center shall be under the management of' a licensed and qualified physician duly authorized by the Department. ' Thus, notwithstanding our position on the matter, the provisions of the issuances and law mentioned above should be properly observed and complied with. Thank you. Very truly yours, ALIN OIC, DILG
